# telnyx_managed_account_enable (Action)

Enables a disabled managed account again.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Optional

- `reenable_all_connections` (Boolean) When true, all connections owned by this managed account will automatically be re-enabled. Note: Any connections that do not pass validations will not be re-enabled.
